ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: To read your passport, and to take a photo of a document or your profile picture. Nothing is uploaded until you check it.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To add a photo of a document or a profile picture you choose.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: To open your Wallet and the app with Face ID.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: To show who’s already on Mada. Numbers are matched on this phone and never stored.
